Publications

1,357 unique Scopus documents by the centre's 20 current members, from biomass conversion and carbon materials to water treatment and bioprocessing.

Go to the full list

Scopus As of 29 Sep 2026 Unique documents of the 20 current members; a paper co-authored by several members is counted once.

Eight papers to start with

The most cited paper in four group records, then four recent papers in top-quartile journals.

  1. 2,105 Scopus citations, EnTeCH, BEAR

    Review of technologies for oil and gas produced water treatment

    Journal of Hazardous Materials, 2009

    Brings together the technologies for treating produced water from oil and gas operations in one reference. It is the centre's most cited paper in Scopus.

  2. 1,799 Scopus citations, CCBU

    Cationic and anionic dye adsorption by agricultural solid wastes: A comprehensive review

    Desalination, 2011

    Reviews how agricultural solid wastes adsorb both cationic and anionic dyes, pointing to low-cost sorbents made from residues that would otherwise be discarded.

  3. 838 Scopus citations, BEAR

    Bioprocess engineering of microalgae to produce a variety of consumer products

    Renewable and Sustainable Energy Reviews, 2010

    Sets out the bioprocess engineering steps for growing microalgae and turning the biomass into a range of consumer products.

  4. 224 Scopus citations, HyNeX

    Dynamic mechanical properties of natural fiber reinforced hybrid polymer composites: a review

    Journal of Materials Research and Technology, 2022

    Reviews the dynamic mechanical behaviour of hybrid polymer composites reinforced with natural fibres, a basis for replacing synthetic fibres with plant-based ones.

  5. Q1 journal, 2026, CCBU

    Gasification of Malaysian agricultural and industrial biomass in CO2: A physicochemical characterization and thermogravimetric-based ranking approach

    Renewable Energy, 2026

    Characterises Malaysian agricultural and industrial biomass and ranks it for gasification in CO2, using thermogravimetric data to guide the choice of feedstock.

  6. Q1 journal, 2025, CCBU, HyNeX, EnTeCH

    Cellulose-based hydrogels in flexible supercapacitors: A sustainable approach for energy storage solutions

    Renewable and Sustainable Energy Reviews, 2025

    Reviews cellulose-based hydrogels in flexible supercapacitors, linking a renewable material to energy storage. Members from three SPERC groups wrote it together.

  7. Q1 journal, 2025, EnTeCH

    Microwave irradiation-assisted isomerization of glucose to fructose over Mg/Al-doped lignin self-assembled nanospheres

    Applied Catalysis B: Environmental, 2025

    Reports lignin nanospheres doped with Mg and Al that, under microwave heating, convert glucose to fructose, a step in turning plant sugars into chemicals.

  8. Q1 journal, 2026, BEAR

    Microwave-Assisted extraction of lipids from Chlorella sp. using green solvents for sustainable biodiesel production

    Sustainable Energy Technologies and Assessments, 2026

    Tests green solvents with microwave assistance to extract lipids from Chlorella microalgae for biodiesel production.
